steps.title: Configure tip pickup and mount
steps.instruction: Set up the protocol to prepare a 384‑well plate for qPCR: select 1‑14 samples, and if fewer than 14 samples are used the system will pick up the correct number of tips (fewer than 8) to dispense across all columns. Tips will be exchanged per source column in the 96‑well plate. Specify the tip‑pickup starting column (choose a column 1‑12 and ensure that column and the following column together contain 16 tips). Choose the P20 multi‑channel pipette mount (left or right).

substeps.instruction: Set tip‑pickup starting column (1‑12) ensuring 16 tips are available between the selected column and the next column
Select P20 multi‑channel pipette mount (left or right)
Confirm number of samples (1‑14) and that tip count (<8) matches the sample number

steps.title: Pick up multi‑channel tips
steps.instruction: Using the P20 multi‑channel pipette, pick up the appropriate number of tips for the current source column based on the number of samples present.

steps.title: Transfer 10 µL to destination
steps.instruction: Aspirate 10 µL from each well of the source plate and dispense it into the corresponding columns of the 384‑well destination plate according to the plate map.

steps.title: Drop tips and advance column
steps.instruction: Discard the used tips, then move to the next source column and repeat tip pickup if additional samples remain.
